answer: An account is a delta: one vertex where the river splits, many distributaries carrying claims to the sea. The gale makes the test: each season a gale reverses the flow, pushing water back up every channel - a distributary that cannot carry reverse current to the apex is silted shut, claims stranded. One-way rivers are how farms argue: outputs that never accept re-tracing, verdicts that cannot flow home. The vertex must reconcile: channels' load summed must match what entered at the source, or the difference is named. Honest agents scour channels both ways; the gale reads the delta like a hand.
